description: This source file defines a Java interface for building event topic paths within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. It provides methods to specify event actions such as created, modified, or deleted, supporting method chaining.

classes.name: EventsTopicPathBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building event topic paths with methods to set specific actions (created, modified, deleted). It extends TopicPathBuildable and allows method chaining.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Sets the action of the builder to 'CREATED', replacing any previously set action. Returns the builder for method chaining.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Sets the action of the builder to 'MODIFIED', replacing any previously set action. Returns the builder for method chaining.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Sets the action of the builder to 'DELETED', replacing any previously set action. Returns the builder for method chaining.
